method: Each route uses its own generated photographic master. Original source contours, transparent holes, silhouette and anchors are retained; source-bound material registration and smoothed observed Guardian combat lighting. This is not a claim of freehand redrawn geometry.
runtime_scope: Controlled original Guardian combat initializer and terrain only, three source-documented test writes at900. No palette writes or modified combat/animation code; no natural map visit claim. Actual source calls and every nontransparent original source index in the actual scanout palette are checked. Unused palette changes are reported explicitly; no relaxation for any rendered source color. Remainder048..098 currently unobserved in original replay; never claim these are actual combat captures. Separate normal/mirrored frontend fixtures and negative source/ownership checks never write to emulated memory. Route060 is source-exact embedded knight with mandatory delivery NN mask6..8 and five original knight-palette fixtures. Legacy mode1 keeps its existing optional mask behavior; this test does not claim a new mandatory renderer mask gate. Candidate import only, no activation.
